close_reason: Opinion-tagged confirming the existing DownloadBlobParams design is correct. The struct-literal call site forces named association where 6 positional &str args would let callers silently swap fields with no compiler help. Design-validated, no code change needed.
description: src/blob.rs:27-43 — download_blob takes a single DownloadBlobParams<'a> instead of 6 separate &str / Option<&str> arguments. With six string-typed parameters, callers would silently swap blob_id/account_id/name with no compiler help. The struct-literal call site forces named association at every call. Documented in PLAN.md test strategy. Defend against any 'flatten to positional args' refactor.
title: DownloadBlobParams struct rather than 6 positional &str arguments
